rules: Stage 10 backend_legacy_inventory.json is an immutable audit baseline; completed migrations are recorded here instead of rewriting history.
A removed source must have zero active hook, HTTP, Python-import and runtime consumers.
The canonical Door Cutting Order DocType base must remain because Frappe requires the active override to subclass it.
Public compatibility routes remain preserved until their route contract is explicitly retired.
A Stage 11 discovery that was not enumerated in the Stage 10 audit must be recorded explicitly with evidence before removal.

migrations.name: Retired alternate Door Cutting Order controller chain
evidence: Only DoorCuttingOrderController is activated by hooks.py and the alternate controller chain has zero runtime consumers.
Costing and plan ownership are delegated to focused Application/Infrastructure adapters.

migrations.name: Migrate runtime cutting imports to canonical Domain
evidence: Runtime cutting consumers were moved away from legacy import modules to canonical Domain/Application ownership.
Historical import facades remain thin for external Python compatibility and internal runtime scans reject new dependencies on them.

migrations.name: Split Cutting Plan snapshot persistence from lifecycle compatibility
evidence: Snapshot persistence and production-plan freezing moved to cutting_plan_snapshot_service.py.
cutting_plan_service.py remains a thin compatibility facade with no plan persistence ownership.

migrations.name: Split transitional production service into focused owners
evidence: Active stage bootstrap, status synchronization and production event persistence use focused owners directly.
production_service.py is retained only as a backward-compatible/fail-closed facade and has zero internal runtime consumers.

migrations.name: Remove retired replacement cancellation implementation
evidence: Runtime scans prove zero internal consumers of replacement_cancellation_service.py.
The historical route remains frozen to cancel_legacy_replacement, which rejects retired stock-reversal behavior.

migrations.name: Remove retired Stock and Remnant product implementation
evidence: Retired Stock/Remnant HTTP routes remain fail-closed while implementation modules and unused execution gateways are absent.
Revision activation preserves its material-activity safety gate without retired stock/remnant mutation side effects.

migrations.name: Retire historical Order Creation implementation
canonical_owner: Frappe native Door Cutting Order DocType creation flow
evidence: order_creation_service.py is a business-logic-free tombstone with zero runtime imports.
The two historical creation RPC names remain mapped to legacy_endpoint_service.retired_product_endpoint.

migrations.name: Slim the Frappe-required Door Cutting Order base
evidence: The canonical DocType base remains for Frappe subclassing but no longer owns cutting, costing, plan or validation algorithms.
Historical helper signatures needed by preview/simulation paths are thin delegates to focused Application/Infrastructure owners.
Exact special-shape geometry validation was preserved in the canonical Piece Policy adapter after the slimming audit exposed the former base-class dependency.
Static, Security and Frappe v16 Integration are green on the same Batch 8 final SHA.
